title: Formal completion along a closed subset preserves the adic* and Noetherian types
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter formal-spaces.tex (Formal Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file formal-spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For an algebraic space X over a scheme and a closed subset T, the lemma asserts that the completion of X along T is locally adic* when the complement of T maps quasi-compactly to X, and is locally Noetherian when X is (statement lines 4751-4763). The proof reduces both assertions to the affine case along an etale covering of X by a disjoint union of affine schemes: the inverse images of T in the members give closed subsets, the base change of the completion along a member is the completion of that member along that closed subset, and these base changes form a presentation of the completion (proof lines 4765-4773). It then checks that the hypotheses transfer to the members, namely quasi-compactness of the complement of the closed subset and local Noetherianness, so that the affine statement applies (proof lines 4773-4777). The claim is H2: the reduction is made along an explicit presentation and uses the base change identity for completions, and the two transfers of hypotheses are stated; the affine case is a named result.
